title: Where Hungary Is - Hol van Magyarország?

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain where Hungary is located, using Közép-Európában and a Kárpát-medencében.
I can state Hungary's approximate size and population.
I can explain why Hungarian belongs to the Finno-Ugric language family, unlike most of its neighbours' languages.
I can describe how Budapest relates to the country's counties.
I can use van/vannak correctly when describing where something is located.
